Package io.openlineage.client.utils

Class FabricLakehouseUtils

java.lang.Object
io.openlineage.client.utils.FabricLakehouseUtils
public final class FabricLakehouseUtils extends Object
Names Microsoft Fabric lakehouse tables as the naming conventions describe: namespace fabric-lakehouse://<workspace ID>, name <lakehouse>.<schema>.<table>. Lakehouses without schemas use the schema dbo.

A lakehouse table's files are in OneLake, at abfss://<workspace>@onelake.dfs.fabric.microsoft.com/<lakehouse>/Tables/[<schema>/]<table>. That path doesn't say whether the item is a lakehouse, so the caller has to know. This class only converts between a lakehouse table's location and its name.

  • Method Details

    • tableAt

      public static Optional<DatasetIdentifier> tableAt(String lakehouse, OneLakeLocation location, List<DatasetIdentifier.Symlink> symlinks)
      Names the table at a location in a lakehouse. If the lakehouse's ID is known, the table's OneLake path is added as a LOCATION symlink.
      Parameters:
      lakehouse - the lakehouse's name
      location - the table's location: the workspace ID and Tables/<table> or Tables/<schema>/<table>, with the lakehouse's ID when it's known
      symlinks - symlinks to keep, or null
      Returns:
      the table, or empty if the location isn't a table in a lakehouse

    • toOneLakeLocation

      public static Optional<OneLakeLocation> toOneLakeLocation(DatasetIdentifier identifier)
      Describes where a lakehouse table is stored, for the fabric_onelake facet. The workspace comes from the namespace, the lakehouse name from the table name, and the lakehouse's ID and the table's path from the LOCATION symlink.
      Returns:
      the description, or empty if this isn't a fabric-lakehouse dataset named <lakehouse>.<schema>.<table>
